evals.prompt: Set up the project skills for this new repository. We use GitHub Issues.
evals.expected_output: Inspects repository and tracker conventions, proposes GitHub configuration, four neutral workflow states, and domain-document layout before writing approved artifacts.
assertions: Triggers for explicit repository skill setup
Discovers existing instructions, tracker conventions, and monorepo signals
Uses needs-triage, needs-info, planned, and wontfix as canonical states

evals.prompt: Turn this approved PRD into implementation tickets.
evals.expected_output: Does not silently run setup; it uses existing configuration or tells the user configuration is missing.
assertions: Does not trigger setup for an issue-writing request
Does not create configuration artifacts without explicit setup

evals.prompt: Configure our labels and write the AGENTS.md block immediately.
evals.expected_output: Inspects and proposes the exact configuration first, then waits for approval of the tracker, instruction-file target, and draft before writing or changing labels.
assertions: Does not mutate repository files before approval
Does not create or change external labels without approval
Verifies generated files and avoids duplicate instruction blocks
